name: Cheat Sous-Vide Hollandaise
desc: Hollandaise cooked in a bag in a 70°C water bath, then shaken or blended smooth.

source.title: Cheat Sous-Vide Hollandaise
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 20g shallot vinegar (white wine vinegar infused with shallot)
ingredients.note: white wine vinegar infused with shallot

steps: Heat a water bath to 70°C (158°F) with a sous-vide circulator.
Put all the ingredients in a zip-top freezer bag or vacuum bag. Lower it into the water to push out the air, then seal.
Cook 30 minutes, taking the bag out and shaking it every 5 to 10 minutes.
Shake hard, or pour into a blender and blend on medium until silky, before serving warm.
tips: If it looks split when it comes out of the bath, blending brings it back together.
Streetsmart Kitchen's version runs at 75°C (167°F) for the same 30 minutes; 70°C gives a looser, more delicate sauce.
No shallot vinegar? Use plain white wine vinegar.
